reader.requirement: A bare EXIT (the only EXIT format of the 1985 Nucleus) only gives a procedure-name to a point: at run time control passes through it as if nothing were there (a PERFORM range ending at it returns, fall-through continues), and it adds no other effect; EXIT PERFORM/PARAGRAPH/SECTION are not 1985 forms; the witness covers PERFORM THRU to an EXIT paragraph and fall-through.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ExitParagraph2002 / ExitPerform2002 / ExitSection2002 refuse the 2002 structured exits at 1985 (COBOL0900); the bare EXIT is not gated

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the bare EXIT is a no-op at every edition; only the later formats are refused at 1985

reader.notes: Classes a, d, e and f do not apply to a statement with no operands. A first draft of ex1.cob (ex1-002) looped because the probe's own GO TO fell back into a PERFORM; it was stopped within the tool timeout, wrote no output file, and the corrected probe ex1-003 is the evidence.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-107/rex1-001 at --std 85: BACK-S2 0 (PERFORM of a section whose one paragraph is EXIT returns and does not run into the next section); L 1 / L 2 / L 3 / VARY 4 (PERFORM ... THRU an EXIT paragraph VARYING); TIMES (PERFORM of an EXIT paragraph 2 TIMES); S3 / S4 FALL (GO TO a section, fall-through past its EXIT paragraph into the next section). Class b: rex2.cob (EXIT inside IF ... END-IF) and rex3.cob (EXIT DISPLAY in one sentence) refused COBOL2966 (§1985:VI.6.14.3 SR1, the placement under which GR1 applies). Class c: rex4-001 EXIT PROGRAM, a 1985 Inter-Program Communication statement and not this Nucleus EXIT, compiles and returns (SUB / BACK), so the bare-EXIT gate does not over-refuse the other 1985 EXIT form; the reader's ex3 covers the 2002 EXIT PARAGRAPH/PERFORM/SECTION refusals. Classes a, d, e, f do not apply (no operands). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.14.4 GR1 the text is in GR1; OK §1985:VI.6.14.3 SR1 the text is in SR1. Side note, not this rule: COBOL2966's text quotes §2023:14.9.14.3 SR1 ('or in a section without paragraphs') at --std 85, where the 1985 SR1 names only the paragraph.
